title: FP-Prune: Rethinking Visual Token Pruning from an Information Gain Perspective
abstract: arXiv:2611.29327v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Visual token pruning can reduce the inference cost of vision language models, but its effectiveness depends on preserving complementary visual information under a limited token budget. A central challenge is to quantify the additional information a candidate token contributes beyond the retained set, a contribution that conventional scores based on attention or similarity struggle to capture directly. In this work, we revisit visual token pruning from the perspective of information gain and use mutual information to characterize the incremental value of candidate tokens. We further establish theoretically that frame potential serves as an effective surrogate for mutual information. Building on this observation, we propose FP-Prune, a training-free visual token pruning method that iteratively removes tokens with low information gain to preserve as much complementary visual information as possible. translated_title: FP-Prune：从信息增益视角重新思考视觉令牌剪枝
translated_abstract: 视觉令牌剪枝能够降低视觉语言模型的推理成本，但其有效性取决于在有限的令牌预算下保留互补的视觉信息。一个核心挑战在于量化候选令牌在已保留集合之外所贡献的额外信息，而基于注意力或相似度的传统评分方法难以直接刻画这种贡献。在本工作中，我们从信息增益的视角重新审视视觉令牌剪枝，利用互信息来表征候选令牌的增量价值。我们进一步从理论上证明，帧势可以作为互信息的有效替代指标。基于这一观察，我们提出了FP-Prune——一种免训练的视觉令牌剪枝方法，它通过迭代移除信息增益较低的令牌，尽可能保留更多的互补视觉信息。在三个广泛使用的视觉语言模型上的实验……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出FP-Prune，一种免训练的视觉令牌剪枝方法，以帧势作为互信息的理论替代来度量信息增益，通过迭代移除低信息增益令牌，在有限预算下最大化保留互补视觉信息。
en_tdlr: FP-Prune is a training-free visual token pruning method that leverages frame potential as a theoretical surrogate for mutual information to quantify token information gain, iteratively pruning low-gain tokens to maximally preserve complementary visual information under a limited token budget.
